selftext:
// NPC Symbolic + Keyword Engine

HUMAN

BEHAVIOR

REFERENCE

A complete breakdown of human behavior types mapped to actionable keywords for use in NPC AI systems. Each type contains core keywords, trigger conditions, context modifiers, and conflict/amplifier relationships.

12

Behavior Types

200+

Keywords

48

Trigger Conditions

⌕

FILTER //AllInstinctSocialCognitiveConflictInternal

Standard Keyword

Trigger Keyword

Context Modifier

⚡

TYPE 01 — INSTINCT

SURVIVAL

Core self-preservation drives. These override nearly all other behavior types when triggered. Activated by threats to health, safety, or basic needs.

Primary Actions

fleehideretreatavoidhealrestsleepsheltereatdrinkscavengehoardprotectendureconserve

Trigger Conditions

health\_lowthreat\_nearhunger\_highstamina\_lowshelter\_absentdanger\_detected

Context Modifiers

desperatewoundedexposedalonecornered

BASE INTENSITY

9.5 / 10

AMPLIFIERS: fear, pain, isolationSUPPRESSED BY: dominance, duty

🔗

TYPE 02 — SOCIAL

BONDING

Behaviors driven by the need to form and maintain relationships. Humans are tribal; isolation degrades all other systems over time.

Primary Actions

greettalklistenfollowjoinsharehelpcomfortflirtwavebowhuggiftconfidevisitinvitegossipjokecelebrate

Trigger Conditions

ally\_presentknown\_npcloneliness\_highshared\_goaltrust\_sufficient

Context Modifiers

familiarsafe\_zonecelebrationgriefreunion

BASE INTENSITY

7.2 / 10

AMPLIFIERS: trust, familiarity, shared historySUPPRESSED BY: fear, betrayal

🏴

TYPE 03 — INSTINCT

TERRITORIAL

Defining, claiming, and defending personal or group space. Scales with perceived intrusion severity. Can escalate to aggression rapidly.

Primary Actions

patrolguardwarnconfrontchasemarkclaimblockreturnwatchenforceexpelfortifylockbarricade

Trigger Conditions

intruder\_detectedboundary\_crossedresource\_threatenedhome\_nearownership\_established

Context Modifiers

home\_turfresource\_scarceoutnumberedbacked\_upnight

BASE INTENSITY

7.8 / 10

AMPLIFIERS: prior violation, group sizeESCALATES TO: aggression

💢

TYPE 04 — INTERNAL

EMOTIONAL STATE

Reactive states that color and modify all other behavior types. Not actions themselves, but multipliers applied to the behavior engine. Critical for believable NPCs.

Negative States

angryfearfulsaddisgustednervousashamedjealousresentfulgriefhopelesspanickedhumiliated

Positive States

joyfulcuriousproudrelievedexcitedcontentgratefulhopefulconfidentamusedinspired

Neutral / Complex States

boredconflictednumbsuspiciousmelancholicnostalgicindifferent

BASE INTENSITY

8.5 / 10

FUNCTION: Multiplier on all other types

⚖️

TYPE 05 — COGNITIVE

ECONOMIC

Resource acquisition, management, and exchange. Driven by scarcity, opportunity, and perceived value. All economic behavior is ultimately rational, even if irrational in execution.

Exchange Actions

buysellbarternegotiatehaggletradebidinvestcontractloandemand

Acquisition Actions

gatherfarmcraftscavengeminehuntsteallootcommission

Management Actions

stockpilehoardbudgetdistributewastespenddonatetaxtithe

Trigger Conditions

resource\_lowopportunity\_nearmarket\_presentsurplus\_available

BASE INTENSITY

6.5 / 10

AMPLIFIERS: scarcity, greed stat, poverty

👑

TYPE 06 — SOCIAL

DOMINANCE / STATUS

Establishing, maintaining, and signaling hierarchy. Drives NPCs to compete for social position. Interacts heavily with emotional and territorial types.

Assertion Actions

commandboastchallengecompeteleadintimidateimpressflauntposturedeclaredemand\_respect

Suppression Actions

bullymockdismissexcludepunishhumiliatesilenceoverrule

Submission Actions

defersubmitcomplyobeyyieldapologizeflatter

Recruitment Actions

recruitrallyinspiredelegatepromotealign

BASE INTENSITY

7.0 / 10

AMPLIFIERS: pride stat, audience presentCONFLICTS WITH: submission

🔍

TYPE 07 — COGNITIVE

CURIOSITY / EXPLORATION

Information-seeking and environmental engagement. NPCs with high curiosity will wander, investigate anomalies, and seek new stimuli even when safe.

Investigation Actions

searchexamineinspectreadinvestigateaskprobetestsnifflisten\_closelyanalyze

Exploration Actions

wanderfollowopenunlockdiscovermapventureclimbenter

Trigger Conditions

anomaly\_detectedboredom\_highunknown\_presentsafe\_zonenew\_area

BASE INTENSITY

6.0 / 10

SUPPRESSED BY: fear, survival modeAMPLIFIERS: boredom, intelligence stat

🔄

TYPE 08 — COGNITIVE

ROUTINE / HABIT

Scheduled and cyclical behaviors tied to daily life. These create the illusion of a living world and establish predictable NPC patterns players can exploit or disrupt.

Daily Cycle Keywords

wakedresseat\_morningworktravelbreakeat\_middaycontinue\_workreturn\_homeeat\_eveningrelaxsleep

Habitual Actions

praytraincleancookshopgossipdrink\_tavernpracticereadsocializeexercise

Trigger Conditions

time\_of\_daylocation\_homeschedule\_activeroutine\_unbroken

BASE INTENSITY

5.5 / 10

OVERRIDDEN BY: survival, aggression, high emotion

⚖️

TYPE 09 — COGNITIVE

MORAL / ETHICAL

Value-driven choices and judgments. Creates moral weight in NPC decisions. NPCs will choose sacrifice, refusal, or betrayal based on their alignment values. Enables guilt, pride, and redemption arcs.

Altruistic Actions

sacrificeprotect\_innocentwarnreport\_crimeforgiveconfessrefuse\_orderintervenedonate

Self-Interest Actions

betrayliedeceivemanipulateignorecomply\_silentlycover\_upabandon

Judgment Actions

accusepunishcondemnexonerateshunhonortestifymediate

BASE INTENSITY

6.7 / 10

DRIVEN BY: alignment stat, loyalty, fear

🎭

TYPE 10 — SOCIAL

CREATIVE / PLAY

Non-survival expressive behaviors that signal culture, personality, and emotional health. NPCs who play are perceived as more alive. Suppressed by high stress or survival states.

Expressive Actions

singdancedrawwriteperformtell\_storycomposesculptdecoratepaintcarve

Play Actions

gamejokeprankracecompete\_friendlyroleplaymimicdareexplore\_fun

Practice / Growth

practicetrain\_skillstudyexperimentbuildinvent

BASE INTENSITY

4.5 / 10

SUPPRESSED BY: survival, grief, fearAMPLIFIERS: joy, safety, community

⚔️

TYPE 11 — CONFLICT

AGGRESSION

Active conflict behaviors, distinct from territorial defense. Aggression is proactive and offensive. Can be predatory, reactive, or political. Feeds on anger, desperation, and perceived injustice.

Physical Actions

attackambushretaliatedestroyassaultoverpowerdisarmexecutewound

Psychological Actions

threatentauntintimidatemanipulategaslightcoercesuppressundermine

Strategic Actions

stealsabotageframeconspireincitedominatemonopolize

Trigger Conditions

anger\_maxthreat\_activeprey\_weakorder\_giveninjustice\_perceived

BASE INTENSITY

8.8 / 10

AMPLIFIERS: anger, desperation, pack presenceCONFLICTS WITH: submission, fear

🏳️

TYPE 12 — CONFLICT

SUBMISSION / DEFERENCE

Yielding to authority or overwhelming force. The counterweight to dominance. Not weakness — strategic NPCs use submission to survive and bide time. High-intelligence NPCs may fake submission.

Passive Actions

obeykneelfleecomplyyieldavoidhidebe\_silentlower\_gaze

Active Deference

apologizepleadsurrenderconfessflattergrovelbegthank

Strategic Submission

feign\_loyaltybide\_timeplay\_alongpacifybetray\_later

Trigger Conditions

outmatchedauthority\_presentfear\_highloyalty\_activeno\_escape

BASE INTENSITY

6.2 / 10

CONFLICTS WITH: aggression, dominanceAMPLIFIERS: fear, low health, outnumbered

replies.author: Cubey42
replies.body: Thoughts: how exactly would you do the inference for each NPC during a normal playthrough? Are you planning to use an API? This seems like it would become very token expensive if you have many NPCs or many players and would become overloaded. I don't think any local model is going to be very good to use all these tokens without affecting performance. We don't know what kind of game it is we don't know how these NPCs would be used we don't know anything about your product so what feedback could we possibly give you
